cd {{dir}} && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='internal/gateinfer/gateinfer.go'
s=open(p).read()
def rep(old,new):
    global s
    assert s.count(old)==1, old[:70]
    s=s.replace(old,new)
rep('''	"bufio"
	"bytes"
''','''	"bufio"
''')
rep('''// scan feeds each line of the regular file root/rel, of its first MaxRead
// bytes, to each until each returns false. It reports false for no such
// file, a read error or a line over MaxLine, and else whether each stopped
// it: true, for a reader that always asks for more, when the file was read.
func scan(root, rel string, each func(line string) bool) bool {
	f, ok := open(root, rel)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	defer f.Close()
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(f, MaxRead))
	sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 4<<10), MaxLine)
	for sc.Scan() {
		if !each(sc.Text()) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}''','''// scan feeds each line of the regular file root/rel, of its first MaxRead
// bytes, to each until each returns false: stopped says it did, and ok that
// the lines each saw were read, false for no such file, a read error or a
// line over MaxLine.
func scan(root, rel string, each func(line string) bool) (stopped, ok bool) {
	f, ok := open(root, rel)
	if !ok {
		return false, false
	}
	defer f.Close()
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(f, MaxRead))
	sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 4<<10), MaxLine)
	for sc.Scan() {
		if !each(sc.Text()) {
			return true, true
		}
	}
	return false, sc.Err() == nil
}''')
rep('''		var r runLines
		if scan(root, f, r.line) && len(r.out) > 0 {''','''		var r runLines
		if _, ok := scan(root, f, r.line); ok && len(r.out) > 0 {''')
rep('''	if scan(root, "Makefile", makeTest()) {''','''	if found, _ := scan(root, "Makefile", makeTest()); found {''')
rep('''	return scan(root, rel, func(line string) bool {
		return !slices.ContainsFunc(marks, func(m string) bool { return strings.Contains(line, m) })
	})''','''	found, _ := scan(root, rel, func(line string) bool {
		return !slices.ContainsFunc(marks, func(m string) bool { return strings.Contains(line, m) })
	})
	return found''')
rep('''// makeTest is a line reader that stops at a Makefile line declaring a test
// target: scan reports true only for a file that has one.''','''// makeTest is a line reader that stops at a Makefile line declaring a test
// target, so scan says stopped only for a file that has one.''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
gofmt -l internal/gateinfer; go vet ./internal/gateinfer 2>&1 | head -3; echo "vet is not allowed directly";
